name: TIME ERC-2771 Multicall sender spoof
summary: TIME combined a trusted-forwarder ERC-2771 context with self-delegatecall Multicall. A forwarded multicall could append an attacker-chosen address to an inner call, making burn() treat the TIME/WETH pair as the sender; the attacker burned the pair's TIME reserve, synchronized the pool, and drained WETH at the distorted price.

loss.notes: The receipt records 5 WETH entering the TIME/WETH pair and 94.513462587046838316 WETH leaving it, for exact net victim depletion of 89.513462587046838316 WETH. DefiLlama's nearest prior ETH observation values it at $199,339.32. The commonly reported 84.59 ETH is attacker proceeds after the approximately 5 ETH transaction-builder payment. The burned TIME reserve is the mechanism of the same drain and is not valued again.

ageReset.description: The factory CREATE2-deployed and initialized the immutable EIP-1167 clone in one transaction, fixing both its implementation and trusted-forwarder set. The forwarder mapping has no post-initialization setter.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful exploit receipt and call trace, the internal CREATE2 and initializer trace, clone and implementation code history, exact commit-matching deployed sources, OpenZeppelin's disclosure, and pair balance deltas. The trace routes a valid execute call through trusted forwarder 0xc82bbe41f2cf04e3a8efa18f7032bdd7f6d98a81 to TIME.multicall, then self-delegatecalls burn(uint256). Because the delegatecall preserves the trusted forwarder as msg.sender, ERC2771Context extracts the final 20 bytes of the attacker-controlled inner calldata as the sender; those bytes name pair 0x760dc1e043d99394a10605b2fa08f123d60faf84, so 62,227,259,510 TIME is burned from its reserve. After sync and resale, the pair's WETH falls from 89.787809617954054780 to 0.274347030907216464. Factory 0x5dbc7b840baa9dabcbe9d2492e45d7244b54a2a0 CREATE2-deployed the 45-byte clone and initialized its trusted forwarders in block 17319333. The clone runtime hard-codes implementation 0x303a41300baeb37a1028af017b17b8a6edc3066a and hashes to 0x52464d20c6c53775b56a1a0fd48aa0329f8ea1cfa72ba6763d9fc0b2b87d245d from creation through the pre-exploit block. The 18,427-byte implementation was deployed in block 15584730 and hashes to 0x0ea5e21f65bc5ff83018a8349ff3629cecc44e04c44eed18db181f42e1176b9d through the same interval. The clone's deployment is the age reset because it fixed the implementation and the vulnerable forwarder configuration, giving 17,091,096 seconds of code age.
